notes.title: Jul 16, 2020 Update
notes.content:
New features:
Added custom area settings.
Added new localization text.

notes.title: Update: Launch with SteamVR now working
notes.content: The option to auto launch Restrictr when steamvr launches should now work properly.

notes.title: Jan 21, 2020 Update
notes.content: Updated Restrictr to support different sized Play Areas. The Bounds Size maximum value now scales correspondingly to the X and Z size of the Play Area.
